knowledgeBaseManifest.description: Component reference for ops_dashboard: responsibility, domain model, entities, value objects, domain events, domain services, use cases, API endpoints, layer structure, key design decisions, background tasks, React frontend, repository interfaces, and known limitations.

Developer runbook for ops_dashboard: local setup, migrations, staff user creation, Q2 worker operation, manual alert evaluation, frontend build, API testing examples (curl), how to add a new metric type, and troubleshooting guide.

ADR 0007: documents the decision to implement AlertEvaluationService as a domain service invoked by a Q2 scheduled task every 15 minutes, with rationale for rejecting a model method and a signal-based approach.

runbooks.scope: Local development setup, Q2 worker operation, alert evaluation, API testing, adding new metric types, and troubleshooting for the ops_dashboard bounded context
runbooks.audience: Developer working on the ops_dashboard app
